runtime-transport-fault-injection.acceptance: Real guest prepublication hard fault, postpublication notify fault, recovery before deadline and permanent pressure pass with exact phase/ownership assertions.44 protocol tests alone do not satisfy this gate.

vector-avx512-state.acceptance: Both engines report required leaf7 feature bits, OSXSAVE and XCR0 contains0xE6, CPUID0xD permits/components fit reviewed allocation and signal/scheduler state sizes. HistoricalTCG0x21f does not enable this.

vector-context-observer.acceptance: Assembly load-transition-store windows, matched real McKernel TIDs and proven intervening execution observe live architectural registers before any ABI-permitted library clobber.

vector-extended-signal-abi.acceptance: Full selected Linux-compatible xstate signal-frame size/alignment/features/metadata and checked restore contract reviewed and guest-verified; larger CPUID state cannot be inferred from legacy FP signal smoke.

vector-first-entry-observer.acceptance: Reviewed minimal static ELF reaches its custom _start before loader/libc FP use; controlled prior poison-owner retirement and first-instruction snapshot prove exec initialization without asserting zero state after pthread/libc startup.

vector-instruction-audit.acceptance: Exact payload ELFs and scalar reference disassembly prove required opcodes/widths, preserved-register critical windows, no accidental optional instruction in dispatch and no auto-vectorization or contraction in independent scalar references.

vector-kernel-opcode-audit.acceptance: Pinned disassembler decodes all selected McKernel executable sections and unchanged three host modules; unexpected vector/x87/MMX operations rejected, only exact reviewed FP-management instruction ranges allowed.

vector-local-signals.acceptance: Real in-McKernel self/thread-directed delivery and locally nested handlers verified; handler clobber and interrupted-state restoration observed with raw assembly. External forwarding remains a separate blocked capability.

vector-runtime-discovery.acceptance: Baseline-generic CPUID leaf0/1/7/0xD and guarded XGETBV(0) captured separately in pinned Linux guest and McKernel; feature masks and enabled xstate offsets/sizes independently checked. No optional instruction before both-engine gate.

scheduling_rule: Preserve original queue order among eligible packets; at most three active logical cases. Family routing is not runtime release. Blocked advanced members of M04 continue in M06.
